# meshstack_api_key (Resource)

Manages a meshStack API key.

~> **Preview:** This resource is in preview. Breaking changes are possible without prior notice due to changes in the underlying [meshStack preview API](https://docs.meshcloud.io/api/technical-specifications#preview-endpoints) or due to changes in this provider. Please ensure you are running the latest version of the provider and report any bugs via [GitHub issues](https://github.com/meshcloud/terraform-provider-meshstack/issues) or via support@meshcloud.io.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meshstack_api_key" "example" {
  metadata = {
    owned_by_workspace = data.meshstack_workspace.example.metadata.name
  }

  spec = {
    display_name = "ci-key"
    permissions  = ["LANDINGZONE_LIST", "PROJECT_LIST"]
    # expires_at is optional; if omitted the key never expires.
    # Setting an expiry is recommended for security best practices.
    # expires_at = "2025-12-31"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) API key metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) API key specification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Read-Only

- `status` (Attributes) API key status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `owned_by_workspace` (String) Identifier of the workspace that owns the API key.

Read-Only:

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the API key (server-generated).


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the API key.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions assigned to the API key. See [API Permissions](https://docs.meshcloud.io/api/authentication/api-permissions/) for detailed documentation. Each permission exists as a workspace-scoped variant, an admin-scoped (`ADM_`-prefixed) variant, or both. `ADM_`-prefixed permissions grant access across all workspaces. `MANAGED_`-prefixed permissions grant cross-workspace access scoped to resources managed by the API key's workspace (e.g. building block definitions, landing zones, or platforms it owns). In the list below, `[ADM_]` marks an optional prefix, `(MANAGED_|ADM_)` a prefix that is one of the alternatives, and `(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)` one of the actions.
  - API Keys: `[ADM_]APIKEY_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Building Blocks: `[ADM_]BUILDINGBLOCK_DELETE`, `[MANAGED_|ADM_]BUILDINGBLOCK_(LIST|SAVE)`
  - Building Block Definitions: `[ADM_]BUILDINGBLOCKDEFINITION_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`, `ADM_REVIEW_PUBLICATION`
  - Building Block Runs: `(MANAGED_|ADM_)BUILDINGBLOCKRUN_(LIST|SAVE)`, `(MANAGED_|ADM_)BUILDINGBLOCKRUNSOURCE_SAVE`, `(MANAGED_|ADM_)BUILDINGBLOCKRUNARTIFACT_(LIST|SAVE)`
  - Building Block Runners: `[ADM_]BUILDINGBLOCKRUNNER_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Communication Definitions: `[ADM_]COMMUNICATIONDEFINITION_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Communications: `[ADM_]COMMUNICATION_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Event Logs: `[ADM_]EVENTLOG_LIST`
  - Integrations: `[ADM_]INTEGRATION_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Landing Zones: `[ADM_]LANDINGZONE_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Payment Methods: `ADM_PAYMENTMETHOD_(DELETE|SAVE)`, `[ADM_]PAYMENTMETHOD_LIST`
  - Platform Instances, Platform Types, Locations: `[ADM_]PLATFORMINSTANCE_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Project Role Bindings: `[ADM_]PROJECTPRINCIPALROLE_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Project Roles: `ADM_PROJECTROLE_(DELETE|SAVE)`
  - Projects: `[ADM_]PROJECT_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Service Instances: `[ADM_]SERVICEINSTANCE_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Tag Definitions: `ADM_TAGDEFINITION_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Tenant Usage Reports: `[ADM_]TENANTUSAGEREPORT_LIST`
  - Tenants: `[ADM_]TENANT_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`, `(MANAGED_|ADM_)TENANT_IMPORT`, `(MANAGED_|ADM_)TENANTDELETION_APPROVE`
  - Terraform States: `[MANAGED_|ADM_]TFSTATE_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Users: `ADM_USER_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Workspace Role Bindings: `[ADM_]WORKSPACEPRINCIPALBINDING_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`
  - Workspace User Groups: `ADM_WORKSPACEUSERGROUP_(DELETE|SAVE)`, `[ADM_]WORKSPACEUSERGROUP_LIST`
  - Workspaces: `[ADM_]WORKSPACE_(DELETE|LIST|SAVE)`

Optional:

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry date of the API key (ISO date, e.g. `2025-12-31`). If omitted, the key never expires. Setting an expiry is recommended for security best practices. Changing this rotates the secret and a new client_secret is returned.


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) The client ID used for authentication.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret for authentication. Stored in state after creation and rotated when `expires_at` changes. The API only returns this value on create and on secret rotation.
